'''swcironecg PPD 14: Local Uprising (V)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[swcironecg]]
* '''Published:''' 9 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 LU swcironecg LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Imperial troops have landed beyond the shield and are headed for Echo Base. Commander Skywalker, ready Rogue Squadron for counter-assault!

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Between Rieekan, Luke, Echo Base Garrison, and Manuevering Flaps (V), you should have no trouble getting Rogue Squadron set up on Hoth. Then just play T-47 Battle Formation, add on the direct damage from the objective, and retrieve a few force with Frostbite (V), and you should be well on your way to victory. Thanks to all that helped build the deck!

NOTE: I added Houjix to the sideboard so that if you want you could add it in to counter Sunsdown & To Cold For Speeders, which could really put a hurt on this deck.
